baseline: native HazardGBM default refit; not recovered pushed booster

primary.metric: Paid Brier mean of days 28 and 91; equal weight per World
primary.resampling: 1000 firm resamples within each fixed World, then equal-World mean; not uncertainty across new economies

limitations: retrospective paired benchmark; every evaluation World has already been inspected; not fresh confirmation
exact same V6 fit anchors/order and values of the common 46 features; not a full replay of old ingestion
comparison of model versions including native configuration; not isolated component attribution
binary Paid scores only; no padded-zero Write-off scores for legacy T1
post91 legacy tail is geometric extrapolation, not a fitted 53-week model
restricted quantile metric is for min(time-to-paid,120), not uncapped time-to-payment
cash comparison uses T1 full-payment proxy, not the complete legacy T6 pipeline
